content.theory:
Lists organize related items. HTML has three kinds: ### Unordered lists (`
    `) Items get bullet points. Order doesn't matter: ```html
    • Coffee
    • Tea
    ``` ### Ordered lists (`
      `) Items get numbers. Order matters: ```html
      1. Wash the rice
      2. Boil water
      ``` Each item is wrapped in `
    1. ` (list item). The browser handles the bullets or numbers — you never type them yourself. ### Nested lists You can put a list inside a list item: ```html
      • Fruits
        • Apple
        • Mango
      ``` ### When to use which - **Steps, rankings, top-10s** → `
        ` (order matters) - **Features, shopping lists, tags** → `
          ` (order doesn't matter) - **Definitions (term → description)** → `
          `, `
          `, `
          ` Lists are block-level, so each list starts on a new line.
